items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: I played, I was in the band when Morris French was playing Trombone with him.

ctx.x: What about, uh, Morris French? Did you have another?
Morris French was a trombone player too. Well, Morris French played with Kid René a while too. Mm-hmm. He played with René a while.
Were you in the band then?
